C0887.title: Unauthorized Access Vulnerability in Driving Training System Exposes Millions of Student Records in Guangzhou
C0887.summary: In March 2022, Guangzhou police found that a technology company platform supplied to driving schools processed student personal information, and related data was being sold online. Investigation found that the company had not established data security management systems or operating procedures, had not de-identified or encrypted the information, and had an unauthorized access vulnerability. Police issued a warning and a 50,000 yuan fine, making it Guangdong first administrative enforcement case applying the Data Security Law and highlighting the data security responsibility of platform operators that provide systems externally.
